# =============================================================================
# Top40EcoBoostMod - per-nation eco setup (GENERATED by gen_ecoboost_configs.py).
# DO NOT HAND-EDIT - edit SELECT_ECOBOOST_FINAL_v2.csv and re-run.
# eco_setup_<TAG> (day-1, eco.2): flavour one-shot + ONE champ-category throughput/wage
#   modifier (20yr) + the global SoL/edu modifier (whole game) + first spread pulse.
# eco_pulse_<TAG> (re-run yearly via eco.5): spread champ (N=tier/2) + support (N=tier/4)
#   across states via eco_pulse_spread (covers newly-annexed states). No per-state modifiers.
# =============================================================================

# Set the runtime-safe flags at startup (all targets alive). var:eco_target -> the generic
# eco_is_target_country check; var:eco_tag_<TAG> -> the per-tag eco.2/eco.5 dispatch. Uses
# c:TAG ?= (scoping) so it never errors on a missing tag.
eco_set_target_flags = {
	c:CHI ?= { set_variable = eco_target  set_variable = eco_tag_CHI }
	c:RUS ?= { set_variable = eco_target  set_variable = eco_tag_RUS }

# ---- China (CHI): champ tea [plant] N=5; support x6 N=2; flavour x9 ----
eco_setup_CHI = {
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_coal_mine TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_lead_mine TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_sulfur_mine TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_dye_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_opium_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_tobacco_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_banana_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_cotton_plantation TYPE = flavour }
	eco_seed_flavour = { B = building_vineyard TYPE = flavour }
	add_modifier = { name = eco_champ_tp_plant months = 240 }
	add_modifier = { name = eco_sol_edu_global }
	eco_pulse_CHI = yes
	if = { limit = { is_player = yes } trigger_event = { id = eco.4 } }
	eco_cleanup_flags = yes
}
eco_pulse_CHI = {
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_tea_plantation N = 5 TYPE = champ }
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_fishing_wharf N = 2 TYPE = support }
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_logging_camp N = 2 TYPE = support }
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_furniture_manufactory N = 2 TYPE = support }
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_textile_mill N = 2 TYPE = support }
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_food_industry N = 2 TYPE = support }
	eco_pulse_spread = { B = building_silk_plantation N = 2 TYPE = support }
}
